verdict.rationale: Azure's own Terraform documentation lists "Export resources to HCL code", a first-party path for bringing existing resources into IaC rather than only building new ones. The evidence is a single heading, though, with no detail on how the workflow runs. Bicep and ARM templates appear only as declarative deployment languages, with no import or drift capability evidenced. Missing for 10: documented drift detection/what-if workflow, Bicep/ARM import of existing resources, depth on the export-to-HCL workflow (scope, state import), independent or hands-on corroboration.
